title: Automatized lung disease quantification in patients with COVID-19 as a predictive tool to assess hospitalization severity.
summary: retrospective single-center 476 COVID-19 patients; CACOVID-CT quantifies affected lung area and CT severity score, correlated with length of stay, ICU admission, ventilation and death. Internal observational evidence only.
ai_technology: AI quantification is tied to patient outcomes in a defined clinical study; no causal or clinical-impact claim.
